source_name: ResearchAndMarkets — Ukraine Cards and Payments 2026 (report reseller listing)
why_relevant: Aggregator/reseller that lists Ukraine payment- and card-market reports from many publishers (GlobalData, Euromonitor, others). Its catalogue is the fastest way to enumerate which commercial houses actually cover Ukraine payments and how often they refresh; listings carry free scope/TOC text with segment definitions.

source_name: Statista Market Insights — Digital Payments Ukraine outlook
why_relevant: Modelled market sizing and forecast for Ukrainian digital payments with partially free headline values (e.g. total transaction value projections); useful as a cross-check on vendor sizing and as a pointer to the primary inputs Statista names in its methodology notes.

source_name: Deloitte Ukraine — insights and banking sector overview publications
why_relevant: Big Four local practice; publishes recurring 'Overview of Ukraine's banking sector' style reports (a 2023-2024 Kyiv edition is cited in Ukrainian academic literature) plus digital-banking maturity benchmarking covering hundreds of banks. Free PDFs; methodology reveals which NBU and bank-reporting series they build on.

source_name: PwC Ukraine — Аналітичні огляди (analytical surveys hub)
why_relevant: Central index of PwC Ukraine's free survey publications, including CEO Survey cuts for the financial-services sector and CEE banking material. Acts as a pointer page enumerating every PwC UA research product, several of which touch banking digitalisation and payments.

source_name: KPMG Ukraine — Дослідження та бізнес-публікації
why_relevant: KPMG Ukraine's insights index aggregating local market research, CEO Outlook Ukrainian cuts and sector commentary; free access and a reliable enumerator of KPMG UA financial-services deliverables and their authors (useful for expert mapping).

source_name: EY Ukraine (ey.com/uk_ua) — insights and financial services publications
why_relevant: Fourth Big Four local practice; expected to publish Ukrainian-language banking/financial-services commentary, business-climate surveys and transaction advisory notes. Included for completeness of the Big Four actor map; specific Ukraine banking report not confirmed in this pass.

source_name: Rating agency Standard-Rating (Стандарт-Рейтинг, Ukraine) — research products
why_relevant: NSSMC-authorised Ukrainian rating agency (certificate No.8, 10.04.2012) that publishes a recurring information-analytical study 'Діагностика стабільності банківського сектору України' covering capital, liquidity, profitability and asset quality across the banking system — a rare non-NBU systemic diagnostic, plus a public rating list of individual banks.

source_name: IBI-Rating (Рейтингове агентство «ІВІ-Рейтинг»)
why_relevant: Long-running Ukrainian national-scale rating agency covering banks, insurers, issuers and municipalities. Rating action press releases contain bank-level financial commentary and sector context; useful for tracking which banks remain rated and on what data.

source_name: Expert-Rating (Експерт-Рейтинг)
why_relevant: Described as the largest operator of Ukraine's voluntary (non-mandatory) rating market; issues bank and insurer ratings and accompanying analytical commentary on the national scale.

source_name: Rating agency Rurik (РА «Рюрік») — banking system analytical reviews
source_subtype: national rating agency / sector review series
why_relevant: Ukrainian national rating agency that has historically published a quarterly 'Аналітичний огляд банківської системи України' PDF series with system-level aggregates — a template product worth checking for continuity into the war period.

source_name: Fitch Ratings — Ukraine banks sector and issuer rating actions
why_relevant: International rating agency; free rating-action commentaries on Ukrainian banks (Oschadbank, Ukreximbank, Sense Bank) carry operating-environment assessments, asset-quality and profitability data points and forward-looking sector views usable as an independent cross-check on NBU narratives.

source_name: Moody's Ratings — banking outlooks and Ukraine bank credit opinions
why_relevant: Global banking outlook executive summaries are free and set the comparative frame; Ukraine-specific bank credit opinions and sovereign-linked commentary provide independent sector risk assessment and, in methodology sections, the primary data series relied upon.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings — Ukrainian banking sector outlook research (free PDF assets)
why_relevant: S&P publishes free-standing PDF sector outlooks for the Ukrainian banking sector (e.g. 'Ukrainian Banking Sector Outlook: Clean-Up And Renewed Growth'), containing sector aggregates, BICRA-style risk scoring and named data sources — a durable, citable analytical baseline.

source_name: Info Sapiens — Ukrainian research agency (successor to GfK Ukraine), financial-behaviour studies
why_relevant: ESOMAR-compliant Ukrainian survey house that runs the commissioned national financial literacy / financial inclusion / financial behaviour studies (for NBU and USAID Financial Sector Transformation), publishing full free PDFs with demographic breakdowns of card ownership, cash preference and payment behaviour — demand-side data that no regulator series provides.

source_name: Factum Group Ukraine — research holding
why_relevant: Full-service Ukrainian research holding (part of the international Factum Group network) doing consumer, media and corporate-reputation research plus data-analysis consulting; conducts syndicated market studies for industry bodies (e.g. the VRK advertising/communications market study), a model likely repeated for financial-services clients. Press summaries of its syndicated work are free.

source_name: Gradus Research — Ukrainian mobile-panel research company
why_relevant: Fast-turnaround Ukrainian consumer panel house that publishes free public-interest reports; a plausible producer of consumer payment-behaviour and cash-usage snapshots during the war period. Free report library makes it cheap to monitor.

source_name: Ukrainian Marketing Group (Українська Маркетингова Група, UMG)
why_relevant: Established Ukrainian full-service research agency; relevant as a commissioned-research supplier to banks and payment companies, and its published case/portfolio pages indirectly reveal which financial institutions buy consumer research and on what questions.

source_name: Ukrainian Sociological Portal — directory of research organisations (Дослідницькі організації)
why_relevant: Curated directory enumerating Ukrainian research and survey organisations — the cheapest way to complete the local research-house actor map beyond the handful of well-known names and to find niche agencies that may run financial-services panels.

source_name: YouControl — Bank FinScore index and banking analytics
why_relevant: Commercial business-intelligence house that computes Bank FinScore, a scoring index built from ~25 indicators derived from NBU prudential norms and financial ratios (liquidity, capital adequacy, profitability, credit/investment/currency risk), producing a public ranking of Ukrainian banks. Methodology documentation reveals exactly which NBU series are machine-readable and reusable.

source_name: Opendatabot — commercial open-data analytics service
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator of Ukrainian state registries that regularly publishes free analytical notes and press-friendly statistics; its financial-sector notes are an early-warning feed and its API is a machine-readable route to company/registry data underpinning market sizing.

source_name: Bankografo.com — banking analytics service
why_relevant: Ukrainian bank-analytics site presenting reworked NBU reporting as comparative bank-level analytics and rankings; useful as a ready-made derived dataset and as a check on how commercial actors normalise NBU statistical forms.

source_name: Stakeholder.com.ua — Ukrainian banks statistics and analytics section
why_relevant: Commercial analytics/media hybrid publishing bank asset, reporting and ranking material; a low-cost secondary aggregator useful for spotting which figures circulate publicly and for snowballing to the underlying agency reports.

source_name: MarketResearch.com — Ukraine banking/payments report catalogue
why_relevant: Second major report reseller; cross-checking its Ukraine catalogue against ResearchAndMarkets surfaces publishers that list on only one platform (e.g. Mordor Intelligence electronic-payments series), improving completeness of the commercial-publisher map.

source_name: Mordor Intelligence — POS terminal market report family (Europe / global, Ukraine as sub-segment)
why_relevant: Mordor publishes country-level POS terminal reports for several European markets and a Europe-wide POS/mPOS series; no standalone Ukraine POS report was found, but the Europe report's free market-size and segmentation pages are the closest commercial estimate of Ukrainian POS/mPOS terminal installed base and vendor share — directly on-topic for ATM/POS data.

source_name: Interfax-Ukraine press-release channel (пресрелізи) — rating agency and consultancy study announcements
why_relevant: Paid-placement press-release wire used by Ukrainian rating agencies and research houses to announce studies; the release text routinely reproduces the headline findings and key aggregates of otherwise paid reports, making it a free proxy for their abstracts and a discovery feed for new studies.

source_name: World Bank Global Findex Database (main publication & data portal)
why_relevant: Only global demand-side survey source with comparable Ukraine indicators on account ownership, digital payment making/receiving, card use, cash-out behaviour; 2025 edition covers 141 economies incl. Ukraine and is the standard benchmark for financial-inclusion narratives about UA.

source_name: World Bank Findex 2025 microdata (Ukraine unit-record survey)
why_relevant: Unit-record Ukraine survey data allows custom cuts (rural/urban, age, income quintile) on card usage, digital payments and cash reliance that the published tables do not offer.
